blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania offers is a long-held dream. Spotting Africa’s Big Five on an epic Tanzania safari, climbing Kilimanjaro, unwinding on Zanzibar’s paradise beaches: Tanzania has all of it. Even better, Your Tanzania Trip can create a custom-made itinerary that fits every one of your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?

blocks.html: Whether you pick one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would like to customise your trip, we’re happy to help. Come along and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you like it!

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: Walking out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, you’re greeted with a big smile by your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' Your guide drives you straight to your hotel so you can relax and enjoy the African atmosphere. On the following day, the two of you set off on an exclusive, private safari where you travel at your own pace. With a safari jeep of your own, you can stop and watch the animals for as long as you please!

blocks.orig: Lake Manyara National Park lies between Tarangire National Park and the Ngorongoro Crater, right along the 400 meters deep Great Rift Valley. The park boasts a variety of landscapes that attract many different animals. You can for example visit the lake that covers 75 percent of the park, pass through a dense rainforest with hundreds of monkeys and birds, and see elephants up close in the woodlands.
blocks.html: Situated between Tarangire National Park and the Ngorongoro Crater, Lake Manyara National Park runs right alongside the 400-metre-deep Great Rift Valley. Its wide range of landscapes attracts many different animals. You can, for example, visit the lake covering 75 percent of the park, make your way through dense rainforest alive with hundreds of monkeys and birds, and see elephants at close range in the woodlands.

blocks.orig: Serengeti National Park is widely known as the place to go on safari, mainly because of the Great Migration that passes through here. The enormous, stampeding herds are impressive, as are the vast number of predators that live here: over four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas, and hundreds of wild dogs! And of course, plenty of other beautiful animals, which your guide will be delighted to search for together with you. Are you ready for this?
blocks.html: Serengeti National Park is widely known as the safari destination, largely because the Great Migration passes through it. The vast stampeding herds are impressive, and so is the sheer number of predators found here: more than four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas and hundreds of wild dogs! Naturally there are lots of other beautiful animals as well, and your guide will love searching for them with you. Are you ready for it?

blocks.orig: The famous Ngorongoro Crater is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. The crater was formed two million years ago when a vast volcano erupted. The fertile lava has created a unique ecosystem, now home to the highest concentration of animals found anywhere in Africa! Once in the crater, thousands of animals such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos surround you, and the views are astounding – you won’t know where to look!
blocks.html: The renowned Ngorongoro Crater is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. It came into being two million years ago when a huge volcano erupted. Its fertile lava produced a unique ecosystem, which today has the highest concentration of animals in all of Africa! Down in the crater, thousands of animals such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos are all around you, and the views are amazing – you won’t know which way to look!

blocks.orig: The last day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax in the lodge a bit longer before heading to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your flight home. Having second thoughts? It's also possible to add a few days to your holiday by going to one of Tanzania's paradise islands, such as Zanzibar, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: It’s your final day! Depending on your flight time, you can stay and relax at the lodge for a while before going to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your flight home. Not ready for it to end? You can also add a few days to your holiday on one of Tanzania’s island paradises, such as Zanzibar, Pemba or Mafia!
